project_name.description: The Gothic project name; used as a base for all resource names.

suffix.description: Deterministic resource suffix derived from the Go module name.

region.description: The GCP region to deploy into.

project.description: The GCP project ID the stack deploys into (scopes services, buckets, and the registry).

bucket_name.description: The GCS bucket name for static assets.

state_bucket.description: The GCS bucket holding the OpenTofu remote state.

gcp_image_uri.description: The full Artifact Registry image URI (including tag) for the Cloud Run container. Supplied at apply time via gothic_image.auto.tfvars.json once the image is built+pushed; defaults to empty so init/validate/destroy don't require it.

enable_domain_mapping.description: Whether this stage serves a custom domain via a Cloud Run domain mapping. local.custom_domain is resolved from raw/SSM/Secrets; the Google-managed TLS certificate is provisioned automatically once the domain is verified.
